newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Holiday supply tightness seen.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Holiday supply tightness seen.

text.p: Spot millfeed supplies were scarce for prompt shipment because of reduced production schedules next week at many flour mills, dealers said.
In addition to tight supplies, frigid weather in the central U.S. has increased demand for livestock feed.
"There are still people looking for next week stuff," said a Texas dealer. "The cold weather keeps bringing in more business."
North Texas millfeeds traded at $130 per ton Wednesday for prompt shipment, up $3 from Tuesday.
After the holidays, many dealers expect millfeed prices to move lower.
"Middlings (millfeed) are overpriced," said a Buffalo dealer.

Tight supplies because of holiday-reduced flour mill schedules lifted values, as did the recent cold weather. However, with ample sorghum and other feed ingredients available, dealers said millfeed values should drop once production returns to normal levels after the first of the year.
